name: lazynext
description: Lazynext is an AI e-commerce ad studio for generating UGC product ads, reference-ad remakes, AI drama ads, and ad skits, powered by Atlas Cloud multi-model workflows.

scripts.dev: BUILD_TARGET=local npm run platform:prepare && BUILD_TARGET=local next dev -p 3100
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run platform:prepare && next build --webpack
scripts.postinstall: npm run prisma:generate && npm run platform:prepare && node scripts/patch-eslint-plugin-react.mjs
scripts.cf:prepare: DEPLOY_TARGET=cloudflare npm run prisma:generate && DEPLOY_TARGET=cloudflare npm run platform:prepare && node scripts/patch-wrangler-types.mjs
scripts.cf:build: npm run cf:prepare && opennextjs-cloudflare build --dangerouslyUseUnsupportedNextVersion && node scripts/trim-prisma-wasm.mjs
scripts.cf:preview: npm run cf:prepare && opennextjs-cloudflare build --dangerouslyUseUnsupportedNextVersion && node scripts/trim-prisma-wasm.mjs && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run cf:prepare && opennextjs-cloudflare build --dangerouslyUseUnsupportedNextVersion && node scripts/trim-prisma-wasm.mjs && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .open-next/dist && node scripts/patch-worker.mjs && npx wrangler deploy --no-bundle --config .open-next/dist/wrangler.jsonc
